name: adaptive-prompt-architect
description: Context-aware Agent Skill that silently refines rough requests, voice transcripts, and streams of thought, then completes the task without changing user intent.

interface.shortDescription: Refines rough requests and completes them
interface.longDescription: Turns typo-filled notes, voice transcripts, and streams of thought into a minimal internal execution specification, then completes the task. Prompt-only and show-and-execute modes remain available.
defaultPrompt: Silently refine my rough request using relevant context, then complete the task.
Turn my latest message into a copy-ready prompt only.
Глубоко уточни мой последний запрос и выполни его.
